calls.prompt: Create ONE move only: VALOR R3 fantasy game VFX. Use attached valor reference, same palette and motif as reference, but line weight ~2x thicker, brighter core, wider footprint that extends well beyond a small character standing at center, designed to be partially hidden behind a character sprite. Coral orange warm gold ivory painted angular edges. Output a horizontal three-panel source strip, three equally spaced isolated effects on true transparent background, large empty gutters, NO panels/borders/text/characters/UI/music notes. Left prepare: bold broad low elliptical floor ring gathering. Middle peak: THREE thick nested elliptical floor rings, broad low footprint; bottom ring widest, strong ivory gold cores coral glow; all rings LOW at ankle-to-knee height, NOT tall cylinder. Produce horizontal strip of THREE separate isolated effects, prepare peak settle left-to-right, true transparent background, each within its own equal square third with at least 12% EMPTY transparent margin every side, effects never touch. Peak: same BROAD floor pool with bright thick elliptical rim and narrow short central light column rising behind recipient, pillar height at most equal pool width, no opaque wall. Crisp thick light cores, controlled glow. Must read at 90-100px alpha .7 on dark #1a2447.

EVADE R3 only fantasy game VFX. Use attached reference, same palette and motif as reference, but line weight ~2x thicker, brighter core, wider footprint that extends well beyond a small character standing at center, designed to be partially hidden behind a character sprite.
